body:
A fake security team wrote this demonstration lure. It copies the urgency of a real notice and then asks for secrets a real office will not ask for by email.

The body threatens that the account will be deleted tonight unless you verify your identity and read back a one-time code to someone on the phone.

Use http://benefits.login.example.com/account before the fake timer ends. The page asks for a password, which is the point of the lure.
